_comment: Measured cmuxTests durations used by cmux_unit_test_shard.py to balance shards by time instead of test count. Each value is the median over source_run_ids. Regenerate from recent green runs' app-host shard logs with scripts/ci/generate_test_timings.py. Suites absent here fall back to method-count estimates, so this file can go stale without breaking anything.
